/bin/bash -lc "python3 -B - <<'PY'
import hashlib,json,pathlib
p=pathlib.Path('cf5ea8/after/browser-record.jsonl')
obs=json.loads(pathlib.Path('cf5ea8/observer.json').read_text())
trans=json.loads(pathlib.Path('cf5ea8/terminal-transcript.json').read_text())
raw=p.read_bytes()
print('hash matches observer:',hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==obs['browser_record_sha256'])
print('hash matches original:',hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==trans['raw_jsonl_sha256'])
print('original event line present:',any(hashlib.sha256(line).hexdigest()==trans['raw_event_line_sha256'] for line in raw.splitlines(keepends=True)))
events=list(map(json.loads,raw.splitlines()))
last_end=events[0]['time_ns']
for i,e in enumerate(events,1):
    if e['kind']"'!='"'browser':
        print(i,e)
        continue
    out=e.get('output')
    valid=hashlib.sha256(out.encode()).hexdigest()==e['output_sha256'] if out is not None else 'omitted'
    key=[line.strip() for line in (out or '').splitlines() if any(s in line for s in ('✗','✓','Settings applied','Email: ','Applying…','StaticText \"On\"','StaticText \"Daily\"','StaticText \"Weekly\"','StaticText \"brief@example.test\"','StaticText \"update@example.test\"','No email is sent'))]
    print(i,repr(e['args']),e['exit'],valid,'gap_ms',round((e['start_ns']-last_end)/1e6,3),'elapsed_ms',round((e['time_ns']-e['start_ns'])/1e6,3),key)
    last_end=e['time_ns']
idx={e['time_ns']:e for e in events}
pos=0
for obs_e in obs['actual_events']:
    for j in range(pos,len(events)):
        e=events[j]
        matches=e.get('args')==obs_e.get('args') and e.get('output_sha256')==obs_e.get('stdout_sha256') and e.get('exit')==obs_e.get('runtime_exit') if 'args' in obs_e else all(e.get(k)==v for k,v in obs_e.items())
        if matches:
            if not all(line in (e.get('output') or '').splitlines() for line in obs_e.get('observed_lines',[])):
                print('mismatched lines',obs_e)
            pos=j+1
            break
    else:
        print('unmatched',obs_e)
print('observer comparison finished')
PY"
